title: Target
description: An explicitly enrolled target environment (spec 7, 13.1, AC-002). A production environment is not automatically an eligible target: selection resolves only against records whose status is enrolled, and production modes additionally require the mode in the recorded opt-in list (spec 13.4).

class.description: Target class that scenario mode eligibility keys on (spec 12.1), for example synthetic-repo.

status.description: Only enrolled targets may be selected. Paused suspends selection without revoking the enrollment record; unenrolled removes it.

enrollment.description: Explicit enrollment evidence. Present exactly while the target is enrolled or paused; removed on unenrollment.

enrolled_by.description: Principal that performed the enrollment. Enrollment is a human-owned decision (spec 5.2).

opt_in_modes.description: Production modes the target owner explicitly allowed. Selection in a production mode fails closed when the mode is absent (spec 13.4 opt-in target selection).

unenrolled_at.description: When the target left enrollment. Required exactly when status is unenrolled.

allOf.description: An enrolled or paused target carries exactly one state marker: its enrollment evidence.
An unenrolled target carries no enrollment evidence: every recorded opt-in lapses on unenrollment.
